complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Integrate Web Platform Toolchain into ElmerFEM Repository
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break this task into discrete steps such as: repo directory scaffolding, root configuration files (.gitignore, .editorconfig, pnpm-workspace.yaml), frontend Vite setup, backend Poetry setup, shared lint-format tooling (pre-commit), and initial GitHub Actions workflow. For each subtask provide acceptance criteria and commands/scripts to execute.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Mostly standard project scaffolding with multiple tech stacks but limited domain logic; coordination overhead moderate.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Decompose into: base compose file authoring, service Dockerfiles/contexts, volume & network definitions, health-check implementation, Makefile command wrappers, and local verification & documentation. Specify expected compose commands and health-check endpoints for each subtask.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Requires composing three heterogeneous services with health-checks and developer UX scripts; some orchestration nuance but well-known patterns.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Split into: FastAPI project layout, DTO & settings definitions, REST endpoint implementations, async job launcher abstraction, in-memory/Redis job store, Docker orchestration wrapper, unit & integration tests, and documentation/readme update.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Involves async process management, state persistence, REST design, and test coverage; higher risk in concurrency and Docker interactions.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down into: Jinja2 environment setup, template authoring per physics, parameter-to-context mapper, unit conversion utilities, rendering function with I/O, and snapshot/solver validation tests.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Template system plus validation logic is moderately complex; requires careful mapping of physics parameters.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Separate into: project Tailwind/daisyUI configuration, API service layer, routing skeleton, dynamic form component with zod schema, progress page, result page, and testing suite (unit + e2e).
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Multi-page UI with form generation and validation; complexity spread across styling, state management, and testing.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Create subtasks: author materials.json & schema, backend data loader and GET endpoint, SIF injection logic, frontend dropdown component, properties modal, and full-stack tests.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Adds data layer and simple UI integration; moderate back-front coordination but straightforward logic.

complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Extend Fortran Code for Simplified Materials
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Outline steps: analyse current Elmer data structures, design MaterialLib.F90, integrate FSON parser, modify ModelDescription.F90, adjust build scripts/Dockerfile, implement JSON mapping, regression solver tests, documentation of new keyword, and code review checklist.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Requires non-trivial Fortran changes, external library integration, and ensuring solver correctness—high technical depth and risk.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Divide into: build KeywordsDump utility, capture JSON during image build, backend pydantic validator layer, frontend zod schema generator, shared validation contract, invalid input test cases, CI integration, and developer docs.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Cross-language introspection of Fortran metadata feeding two validation stacks; significant tooling and serialization work.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Subtasks: identify insertion points in solver loops, implement conditional WRITE statements, add solver flag handling, update Docker build, and regression/performance tests to confirm no physics change.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Localized Fortran edits but must preserve solver integrity; moderate complexity with testing and rebuilds.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Plan: backend WebSocket endpoint, log follower utility, message serializer, frontend WebSocket hook, progress bar component, and integration tests with running simulation.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Requires websocket handling and UI synchronization; manageable but touches both stacks and async flow.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break into: sample VTK dataset collection, meshio parsing module, streaming response with compression, frontend data adapter, Plotly 3D renderer, lazy-loading/optimization, and visual regression tests.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Binary data processing, large payload streaming, and interactive 3D rendering add performance and UX challenges.

complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Segment into: workflow environment matrix definition, frontend test/coverage job, backend test/coverage job, docker compose build & integration tests, coverage upload & gate, artifact/image publishing, PR status checks, and pipeline documentation.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: Comprehensive cross-platform pipeline coordinating multiple languages, containers, coverage, and publishing—high orchestration complexity.
